name: Oatly Low-Fat Oatmilk (Chilled Carton)
whyItWorks: Crafted with enzymatic hydrolysis of gluten-free oats, containing only 0.5g of fat per serving and zero dairy lactose or nuts. The soluble oat beta-glucan is gentle and silky on tender intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake carton well and keep refrigerated. Excellent for baking or stirring into decaf coffee.
